title: Share the bulk rule, keep tax and discount apart

cases.says: Tax on 100 at 0.2 is 120, the discount is 80, and 60 items cost 9.0 each in both channels.
Online and in-store prices agree at 9, 10, 49, 50, 99 and 100 items.
Rates of exactly 0 and 1 are accepted, and a tax rate of 1 doubles while a discount rate of 1 frees.
A bad tax rate and a bad discount rate are each refused with their own rule's message.
The bulk rule is exactly price times its factor, with no rounding to cents: 0.99 for 10 items is 0.99 * 0.95.
Above 100 items both channels still apply the one rule: 500 and 1000 items cost 8.0 each at 10.0, online and in store.
A rate a hair outside 0 to 1, such as -0.0000001 or 1.0000001, is refused: the bounds are exact.
